policy.address: Use the supplied title and last_name.

sources.role: Base collection, privacy, verification, negotiation and closing policy.
Overrides Brief A for the supplied case, including calls with only one returned product.
Authoritative tool names, request fields, response shapes and failure semantics.

sources.reference: Supplied platform reference and compilation requirements
sources.role: Execution and serialization contract. Its examples supply no bank policy.

precedence: Brief B overrides conflicting Brief A rules.
Privacy and successful verification gate all account disclosure and account writes.
Hardship overrides ordinary persuasion and restructuring; a customer may still volunteer a valid promise.
An actual successful transfer overrides every other closing outcome, including recorded promises.
Without transfer, any actual recorded promise wins.
Without a recorded promise, all products noted paid produce paid; otherwise use the first non-paid product reason in account order.
Preserve pre-verification and third-party outcomes; never replace them with a generic collection outcome.
API success is determined by the bank body's ok field, with additional verification fields where applicable; an HTTP success envelope is insufficient.

opening.first_sentence: I am a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank, and this call is recorded.
opening.question: Am I speaking with {title} {last_name}?
opening.confirmation: Only yes, that's me, speaking, or the customer's own name confirms identity ownership. Hello, go ahead and who is this do not.
opening.unclear: Answer AI or suspicion questions first, then make the remaining name ask. Continued uncertainty after the second delivered ask closes not_reached/unclear.
opening.ai: Say that you are Freya Bank's digital assistant.
opening.suspicion: Say the caller can verify the call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number. No number is supplied and none may be invented.

third_parties.privacy: Give no reason for calling or account information. Relatives cannot answer security questions or make an account promise, including relatives offering to pay.
third_parties.ordinary: Ask when the customer can be reached.
third_parties.deceased: Say exactly I am sorry for your loss. Ask nothing further. Close not_reached/deceased.
third_parties.callback: A callback must be later than call now, on today or the next business day strictly after today, between 10:00 and 19:00 inclusive. Today remains an allowed callback date even when it is not a business day.
third_parties.invalid_callback_budget: After one invalid proposal, ask once for another. A second invalid proposal closes not_reached/no_callback. Ask only for missing components of an incomplete otherwise valid proposal.
third_parties.callback_success: Only a successful schedule_callback permits not_reached/callback.

security.date_of_birth: Obtain the customer's answer; submit YYYY-MM-DD. Numeric dates mean day/month/year. Assemble partial answers and use corrections before validation.
security.phone_last4: Obtain four customer-supplied digits, preserve leading zeroes and assemble split digits.
security.validation: Never submit a partial or unreadable answer. Use the dedicated verification action only after local representation validation.
security.wrong_answer_scope: Total across both questions. Retry only the failed question.
security.swapped_hint: On day_month_swapped ask for the month as a word. This does not consume a wrong answer.
security.unreadable_service_response: ok=false is not successful verification and is not itself a counted wrong answer.
security.declining: Explain once that the questions protect the account. A second refusal, including asking the call's purpose instead of answering a security question, closes not_verified/declined.
security.failure: After three wrong answers, direct the customer to the mobile app or a branch and close not_verified/failed.
security.lookup_gate: Both individual questions must have successful bank verification and the service must report all_verified before get_account.

account.opening: State that the collections team is calling about a late payment. State every returned product, past_due amount and days_late, one sentence per product, before any payment question.
account.first_question: For one product: Can you make this payment today? For multiple products: Can you make all of these payments today?
account.subsequent_products: If the customer cannot pay all today, work in account order and start each unresolved product at persuasion attempt 1. Do not repeat the today question for each product.

calendar.anchor: The call's now, never any server or extraction clock.
calendar.business_day: Monday through Friday excluding the listed dates.
calendar.deadline_counting: Exclude today. Advance one calendar day at a time, counting only business days.
calendar.promise_eligibility: Today or later, a business day and no later than that product's deadline.
calendar.nonbusiness_proposal: If not after the deadline, offer the next business day and obtain confirmation of the changed date.
calendar.late_proposal: State and offer the product deadline. Refusing that offer is a flat refusal.
calendar.common_date_override: For one customer-named date covering everything, clamp only products whose deadlines are earlier to their own deadlines. Explain every differing date in the joint read-back and obtain one confirmation.
calendar.vague_dates: Ask once for an exact day. Another vague or missing date proposes the deadline; rewording does not reset the allowance.
calendar.weekdays: This weekday is in the current Monday–Sunday week. Next weekday is in the following Monday–Sunday week. A bare weekday is clarified rather than assigned an undocumented interpretation.
calendar.incomplete_dates: Resolve a missing year or month only when there is a unique candidate within the permissible call horizon; otherwise ask for an exact date.
calendar.persuasion_day: Attempt 1 uses the last business day of this week, or the last business day of next week when today is that day. On a weekend, the current week's last business day is already ineligible under rule 19, so use the next week's last business day. Attempt 2 uses the product deadline.
calendar.representation: API dates are YYYY-MM-DD; callback time is HH:MM. Speak dates as day, month name and year.

amounts.first_offer: Full past_due. Never ask how much the customer can pay.
amounts.full_too_much: Offer the floor once and say the rest remains overdue. Refusing it is a flat refusal. Late-band attempt 2 may name the floor again on the deadline.
amounts.customer_proposal: Accept amounts inclusively between floor and past_due. Below floor, explain that it cannot be recorded and offer the floor once. Above past_due, offer the full past-due amount and obtain confirmation; do not silently cap the amount.
amounts.rounding: No policy rounding, currency conversion, discount, waiver or invented currency symbol. Preserve the customer's valid confirmed numeric amount.
amounts.notation: Use English numeric notation and the supplied amounts. The documents specify no currency.

negotiation.proposal_is_not_refusal: A proposed date or amount is evaluated before refusal handling.
negotiation.flat_refusal: A no to today without a date or amount, an explicit flat refusal, or a non-answer triggers the next permitted persuasion attempt.
negotiation.attempt_1: Full past_due, unless the customer already said that is too much, then floor; use the computed weekly offer date.
negotiation.attempt_2: Late band only: floor on the deadline.
negotiation.limits: Count delivered offers per product. Do not repeat an already rejected amount/date offer. After the permitted attempts, mark the product refused.
negotiation.hardship: Illness, a family death or job loss: one short sympathy sentence, no persuasion, offer support. Acceptance transfers to support. Declining resolves remaining affected products as hardship. Customer-volunteered valid dates or amounts may still produce promises.
negotiation.prohibited: No discounts, waivers, instalment plans, invented figures, terms or explanations.

other_branches.paid: A payment of this past-due amount: explain that payments can take one business day to appear, mark that product paid and continue.
other_branches.dispute: Debt not mine, never had this product, or a claim of historical closure/payoff: mark that product dispute, do not argue or promise it, and continue.
other_branches.restructuring: A new plan or lower-instalment request transfers to restructuring, subject to hardship precedence.
other_branches.human: Before or after verification, ask once whether the assistant can help first. Insistence transfers to general with closing reason human.
other_branches.does_not_want_to_talk: A second statement closes not_verified/declined before verification; after verification resolve unfinished products refused and reconcile recorded promises.
other_branches.unknown_information: Say that the information is not available; do not invent an answer.

promises.confirmation: Read every pending product, amount and date together and ask Do you confirm? Only a clear yes to that read-back authorizes writes.
promises.correction: Revalidate a changed amount or date and repeat the complete pending read-back.
promises.writes: One create_promise per confirmed product, in account order. At most two application attempts per product; retry once after a failed result.
promises.failure: After two failures, retain successful promises, mark that product service_error and explain that it could not be recorded.
promises.duplicate: A recorded promise cannot be edited, cancelled or duplicated during this call. Direct changes to the mobile app.
promises.required_confirmation: After successful recording say exactly You will receive a text message confirming this promise.
promises.transfer: A transfer abandons unrecorded agreements while preserving actual recorded promises.

notes.brief_a: Brief A alone never uses add_note.
notes.active_brief_b: Every returned product without an actual recorded promise receives one successful note unless the call transfers.
notes.timing: Keep reasons pending throughout negotiation and confirmation. Commit notes only at final non-transfer resolution, with no intervening customer question.
notes.transfer_prohibition: No notes before or after any restructuring, support or human transfer.
notes.failed_write: An unsuccessful add_note is not recorded and cannot satisfy the closing prerequisite.

closing_combinations.condition: At least one actual promise and no successful transfer.
No promise, every returned product successfully noted paid.
No promise; first non-paid product note is refused.
No promise; first non-paid product note is hardship.
No promise; first non-paid product note is dispute.
No promise; first non-paid product note is service_error after two promise-write failures.
Repeated identity refusal or repeated unwillingness before verification.
Two invalid callback proposals or no callback can be supplied.
Number does not belong to the customer.
Still unclear after two delivered name questions.

policy.closing_protocol: Resolve required writes, thank the customer and say goodbye, then call close_call as the last bank operation. Omit reason for promise and paid. Hang up silently only after actual closing success. No lifecycle closing tool.

execution.automatic_retries: maxRetries=0 for all bank writes; no automatic repeated security submissions. Application-level promise retry is exactly one.
execution.other_service_failures: The briefs do not assign a new disposition for failed lookup, callback, transfer, note or close operations. Keep the operation unresolved, report failure honestly and do not invent a successful disposition. The API explicitly permits repeating a 500 response because nothing was recorded; no bank-policy maximum is supplied for those safe repeats.
execution.close_retry_interpretation: Normally issue one close_call. A contract-defined 500 may be repeated because no close was recorded; never repeat a successful close or make a different bank call after an attempted close.
execution.notes_finalization: The final note batch and closing run without another customer question. The API supplies no note rollback, so finalization must not open a new transfer solicitation after notes start.

workflow.system_prompt: You are Freya Bank's digital assistant. Speak English, address the customer by their supplied title and last name, and keep questions short and sequential. Follow the current instruction and actual bank results. Never disclose collections, debt, payment, products or account facts before both security questions have passed. Never disclose them to a third party. Never invent information, a customer-service number, a currency, a successful action or an unavailable tool. Never ask how much the customer can pay. A proposed date or amount is not a refusal. After a tool result, immediately speak the permitted next sentence or perform the next permitted action. Only the terminal ends the call. Do not narrate internal state, calculations, tool names or routing. Preserve all conversation history.

identity.name: identity
identity.task_message: No bank tool is available in this turn. If the opening has not actually been spoken in the conversation, first say exactly: I am a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank, and this call is recorded. Then ask: Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}? This also applies when the chat begins with the caller's message and no entry greeting ran. Otherwise deliver this instruction, asking only its one requested question: {{identity_instruction}}. Do not repeat an already delivered opening. Do not independently validate answers or advance security. Do not mention why the bank is calling before verification. Do not count hello or go ahead as name confirmation. If a security answer is split, ask only for the missing part. Never supply an answer for the customer.

extraction_schema.name: reply_ready
extraction_schema.description: Always emit ready for this new caller message, including an unclear reply or non-answer. Do not infer a new caller message from a tool result.

extraction_schema.name: reply_kind
extraction_schema.description: Classify the latest reply. name_confirmed only for yes, that's me, speaking, or the caller stating their own name in answer to the bank's name question. Hello/go ahead are nonanswer. third_party includes a relative offering to pay. deceased means the customer died, not a family bereavement. purpose during security includes asking what the call is about instead of answering. stop means not wanting to talk. A generic question or silence is not a correct security answer.

extraction_schema.name: reply_context
extraction_schema.description: The question actually asked by the most recent assistant speech. confirmation only if that speech asked Do you confirm? Do not infer a question that has not been spoken.

extraction_schema.name: reply_yes
extraction_schema.description: Explicit acceptance or rejection of the most recent question. Hello, go ahead, questions and an incomplete answer are none. Apply any correction in the latest sentence.

extraction_schema.name: answer_text
extraction_schema.description: Only the new customer-supplied name or security fragment from this message. Normalize spoken numbers to digits and preserve leading zeroes. For birth dates retain a spoken month as a word, and keep numeric component order. Never infer a missing birth year or digits. Use the corrected portion of a sentence. Do not copy a previous failed answer. Examples: 04; 2; 7; 14 May 1980; 03/02/1980.

extraction_schema.name: answer_mode
extraction_schema.description: Whether answer_text appends a new fragment, restates a complete answer, replaces the earlier answer after a correction, or supplies no answer.

extraction_schema.name: date_text
extraction_schema.description: A requested callback date only, using the corrected expression. Keep relative dates relative: today, tomorrow, in N days, this monday, next friday. Normalize explicit numeric dates as day/month/year unless already ISO. Do not resolve against the real clock. Empty for unrelated dates.

extraction_schema.name: date_kind
extraction_schema.description: Classify date_text by meaning. A vague period such as next week, month end or salary time is period, never an invented exact date. A weekday expression is weekday. Incomplete ambiguous information is ambiguous.

extraction_schema.name: time_text
extraction_schema.description: Customer's corrected callback time, HH:MM in 24-hour form when unambiguous; otherwise retain the ambiguity. Empty when missing.

transitions.description: Process exactly one new caller reply.

evaluate.name: evaluate

transitions.description: A complete security answer passed representation validation.
Verified caller with loaded and calculated account facts.
One eligible, jointly confirmed, unrecorded promise is ready.
Execute an approved callback, transfer or deferred final note.
Actual outcomes have been reconciled and required writes completed.
Continue protected identity dialogue or report unavailable information safely.
Evaluate the authoritative security result without consuming another caller answer.
Calculate all product facts, or return safely on failure.

collect.name: collect
collect.task_message: No bank tool is available in this turn. Deliver the following instruction faithfully in natural English, without adding a question or changing any amount or date: {{collection_instruction}}. Calculated product facts, for interpretation only: {{calendar_facts}}. Preserve all history. The first account statement must include every product and its full past-due amount and days late before asking about payment. Ask no per-product today question. Never ask how much the customer can pay. A joint read-back must name every pending product, amount and date and end with Do you confirm? A customer correction is a new proposal, not agreement to the old read-back. Never claim an agreed promise was recorded.

extraction_schema.name: reply_ready
extraction_schema.description: Always ready for a new caller message, including an empty, unclear or non-answer reply. Never generate a reply from a tool result alone.

extraction_schema.name: reply_kind
extraction_schema.description: Classify the latest caller reply. Dates or amounts are answer even if preceded by no. too_much means the full amount is unaffordable without a numeric alternative. paid means payment of the current past-due amount; historical closure or payoff, never owned, or debt not mine is dispute. hardship means illness, family death or job loss. restructuring means a new payment plan or lower instalments. stop means unwilling to talk. nonanswer includes unclear, empty and unrelated small talk. change_recorded concerns an already recorded promise, not a read-back correction.

extraction_schema.name: reply_context
extraction_schema.description: Classify the last question actually spoken by the assistant. confirmation only when it explicitly asked Do you confirm? Do not assume an entry action spoke.

extraction_schema.name: reply_yes
extraction_schema.description: Explicit acceptance or refusal of the last spoken question. A correction or alternative proposal is not acceptance of the old terms. Use none for unclear replies and questions.

extraction_schema.name: product_scope
extraction_schema.description: The caller's natural product reference, without inventing an internal ID. Use all for an explicit common proposal covering all products. Otherwise preserve a short unambiguous name such as card, credit card, personal loan, car loan, loan, or card ending 7316. Use current for the product most recently discussed, and empty when no scope is given. A short name need not repeat the full label. Do not decide which runtime ID a name means.

extraction_schema.name: amount_text
extraction_schema.description: Only a new customer-proposed amount, normalized to a plain decimal string with no currency symbol. Interpret the corrected portion: 700, no 800 means 800. Empty for yes, too much, or acceptance of the agent's amount. Never infer an amount from an unrelated number, security answer, date or product suffix.

extraction_schema.name: date_text
extraction_schema.description: Only the corrected customer payment-date expression. Keep relative dates relative to the call: today, tomorrow, in N days, this monday, next friday. Preserve exact day/month/year or ISO and month-name dates. Preserve vague periods such as next week or after my salary. Do not use the real date, invent an exact date for a period, or treat unrelated small-talk dates as payment proposals.

extraction_schema.name: date_kind
extraction_schema.description: Classify date_text by its meaning. next week, sometime later this month, at month end and when salary arrives are period. this friday, next friday and bare friday are weekday. A exact calendar date is exact, today/tomorrow/in N days are relative, and unresolved incomplete dates are ambiguous. Empty proposal means none.

extraction_schema.name: hardship_present
extraction_schema.description: yes if this message mentions illness, a family bereavement or job loss, even alongside a restructuring request or payment proposal; otherwise no.

transitions.description: Evaluate a new proposal, correction, response or exception exactly once.
Record actual success, retry once on failure, or continue to the next confirmed product.

resolve.name: resolve
resolve.task_message: Execute only the approved operation: {{resolution_action}}. {{resolution_instruction}}. Use the named tool now; saying that you will do it is insufficient. Call one tool at a time. Do not offer new payment terms or disclose account information here. For a final note batch, ask no further customer question and do not solicit a transfer. On a failed action, follow what_to_do_next, report failure honestly and never claim it succeeded. Retry only when the result explicitly says the service returned 500 and recorded nothing. Do not change the approved request. A failed transfer never authorizes a transferred closing outcome.

transitions.description: A successful approved resolution operation has updated actual state.

closing.name: closing
closing.task_message: The permitted outcome is already reconciled from actual bank results. First deliver this closing speech, including any recording confirmation and the farewell, unless that exact speech was already delivered: {{closing_instruction}}. Then immediately call close_call. It must be the last bank tool call. Do not ask another question or call any other bank tool. Do not say the call was closed when the tool failed. A bank 500 explicitly recorded nothing and permits repeating only close_call; otherwise report the failure and keep completion unresolved. After successful close_call, say nothing further; the terminal will hang up silently.

transitions.description: The bank actually accepted the sole successful closing operation.

verify_identity.description: Engine-only security validation. Submit only the locally complete customer-supplied answer, date of birth before phone_last4. No automatic retries or partial-answer submissions.

field_descriptions.field: Copy the engine-approved security_field: date_of_birth or phone_last4.
field_descriptions.answer: Copy security_answer exactly. Birth date is YYYY-MM-DD; phone answer is four digits, including leading zeroes.

verify_identity.pre_process_code:
import json
try:
    s = json.loads(vars.get('state_json', '{}'))
    vars['security_status'] = 'pending'
    vars['bank_event'] = ''
    field = str(vars.get('security_field', ''))
    answer = str(vars.get('security_answer', ''))
    s['inflight'] = dict(field=field, answer=answer)
    config['body'] = dict(customer_id=vars.get('customer_id', ''), field=field, answer=answer)
    vars['state_json'] = json.dumps(s)
except Exception:
    vars['security_status'] = 'unavailable'
verify_identity.post_process_code:
import json
try:
    vars['security_status'] = 'unavailable'
    if not isinstance(result, dict):
        result = dict(data=dict())
    result.pop('header', None)
    result.pop('headers', None)
    d = result.get('data')
    if not isinstance(d, dict):
        d = dict()
        result['data'] = d
    s = json.loads(vars.get('state_json', '{}'))
    field = s.get('inflight', dict()).get('field', '')
    ok = str(d.get('ok', False)).lower() == 'true'
    verified = str(d.get('verified', False)).lower() == 'true'
    s['buffer'] = ''
    s['phase'] = 'dob' if field == 'date_of_birth' else 'phone'
    question = 'What is your date of birth?' if field == 'date_of_birth' else 'What are the last four digits of the phone number on file?'
    if d.get('hint') == 'day_month_swapped':
        s['month_word'] = True
        s['say'] = 'Please say the month of your date of birth as a word, together with the day and year.'
        vars['security_status'] = 'month_hint'
    elif ok and verified:
        if field == 'date_of_birth':
            s['dob_ok'] = True
            s['phase'] = 'phone'
            s['say'] = 'What are the last four digits of the phone number on file?'
            vars['security_status'] = 'dob_passed'
        elif field == 'phone_last4' and s.get('dob_ok') and str(d.get('all_verified', False)).lower() == 'true':
            s['phone_ok'] = True
            s['verified'] = True
            s['phase'] = 'loading'
            s['say'] = ''
            vars['security_status'] = 'verified'
        else:
            s['say'] = 'I could not complete verification. ' + question
    elif ok and not verified:
        left = int(d.get('wrong_answers_left', max(0, 2 - int(s.get('wrong', 0)))))
        s['wrong'] = max(int(s.get('wrong', 0)), 3 - left)
        vars['security_status'] = 'wrong'
        if s['wrong'] >= 3:
            s['phase'] = 'final'
            s['close_outcome'] = 'not_verified'
            s['close_reason'] = 'failed'
            s.setdefault('notice', []).append('Please use the mobile app or visit a branch.')
            vars['security_status'] = 'failed'
        else:
            s['say'] = 'That answer did not match. ' + question
    else:
        s['say'] = 'I could not validate that answer. ' + question
    vars['state_json'] = json.dumps(s)
    vars['bank_event'] = 'security'
    d['state_json'] = vars['state_json']
    d['bank_event'] = 'security'
    d['security_status'] = vars['security_status']
    d['what_to_do_next'] = 'Immediately continue with the evaluated security instruction. Do not treat a hint, error or wrong answer as verification.'
except Exception:
    vars['security_status'] = 'unavailable'
    vars['bank_event'] = ''
    if isinstance(result, dict):
        result.pop('header', None)
        result.pop('headers', None)
        result['data'] = dict(what_to_do_next='Say that verification could not be completed. Do not disclose account information or call get_account.')

get_account.description: Engine-only account lookup after both bank security checks succeed. Never call for a third party or unverified caller.
get_account.pre_process_code:
try:
    vars['account_status'] = 'pending'
    vars['account_products'] = []
    vars['bank_event'] = ''
    config['body'] = dict(customer_id=vars.get('customer_id', ''))
except Exception:
    vars['account_status'] = 'unavailable'
get_account.post_process_code:
import json
try:
    if not isinstance(result, dict):
        result = dict(data=dict())
    result.pop('header', None)
    result.pop('headers', None)
    d = result.get('data')
    if not isinstance(d, dict):
        d = dict()
        result['data'] = d
    s = json.loads(vars.get('state_json', '{}'))
    ok = str(d.get('ok', False)).lower() == 'true' and s.get('verified') and s.get('dob_ok') and s.get('phone_ok')
    vars['account_status'] = 'loaded' if ok else 'unavailable'
    vars['account_products'] = d.get('products', []) if ok else []
    if not ok:
        s['phase'] = 'service_wait'
        s['say'] = 'I could not access that information right now.'
    vars['state_json'] = json.dumps(s)
    vars['bank_event'] = 'account'
    d['account_status'] = vars['account_status']
    d['products'] = vars['account_products']
    d['state_json'] = vars['state_json']
    d['bank_event'] = 'account'
    d['what_to_do_next'] = 'Calculate all returned product facts, then state every product before the first payment question.' if ok else 'Say that the account information is unavailable. Do not discuss empty or invented account facts.'
except Exception:
    vars['account_status'] = 'unavailable'
    vars['account_products'] = []
    vars['bank_event'] = ''
    if isinstance(result, dict):
        result.pop('header', None)
        result.pop('headers', None)
        result['data'] = dict(what_to_do_next='Say that the information is unavailable. Do not discuss account facts.')

create_promise.description: Engine-only write of the next jointly confirmed, valid, unrecorded product promise. maxRetries=0; the workflow permits at most two application attempts per product.

field_descriptions.product_id: Actual product_id from the engine-approved write_request, never a spoken label.
field_descriptions.amount: Exact confirmed numeric amount from write_request. Do not round, lower or increase it.
field_descriptions.date: Exact confirmed eligible ISO date from write_request.

create_promise.pre_process_code:
import json
try:
    vars['promise_status'] = 'pending'
    vars['bank_event'] = ''
    s = json.loads(vars.get('state_json', '{}'))
    request = json.loads(vars.get('write_request', '{}'))
    p = [x for x in s.get('products', []) if x['product_id'] == request.get('product_id')][0]
    p['write_attempts'] += 1
    s['inflight'] = dict(request)
    config['body'] = dict(customer_id=vars.get('customer_id', ''), product_id=request['product_id'], amount=request['amount'], date=request['date'])
    vars['state_json'] = json.dumps(s)
except Exception:
    vars['promise_status'] = 'unavailable'
create_promise.post_process_code:
import json
try:
    if not isinstance(result, dict):
        result = dict(data=dict())
    result.pop('header', None)
    result.pop('headers', None)
    d = result.get('data')
    if not isinstance(d, dict):
        d = dict()
        result['data'] = d
    s = json.loads(vars.get('state_json', '{}'))
    request = s.get('inflight', dict())
    p = [x for x in s['products'] if x['product_id'] == request.get('product_id')][0]
    if str(d.get('ok', False)).lower() == 'true':
        p['status'] = 'recorded'
        p['promise_id'] = str(d.get('promise_id', ''))
        s.setdefault('notice', []).append('Your promise for your ' + p['label'] + ' has been recorded.')
        vars['promise_status'] = 'recorded'
        instruction = 'This product was recorded. Immediately continue with the next confirmed product or final resolution. Never write this product again.'
    elif p['write_attempts'] < 2:
        vars['promise_status'] = 'retry'
        instruction = 'The promise was not recorded. Immediately retry the same confirmed request once; do not claim success.'
    else:
        p['status'] = 'done'
        p['reason'] = 'service_error'
        s.setdefault('notice', []).append('I could not record the promise for your ' + p['label'] + '.')
        vars['promise_status'] = 'failed'
        instruction = 'Two writes failed. Do not retry. Preserve other recorded promises and defer this product service_error note until final non-transfer resolution.'
    s['phase'] = 'recording'
    vars['recorded_ids'] = [x['product_id'] for x in s['products'] if x['status'] == 'recorded']
    vars['state_json'] = json.dumps(s)
    vars['bank_event'] = 'promise'
    vars['write_request'] = ''
    d['state_json'] = vars['state_json']
    d['bank_event'] = 'promise'
    d['promise_status'] = vars['promise_status']
    d['what_to_do_next'] = instruction
except Exception:
    vars['promise_status'] = 'unavailable'
    vars['bank_event'] = ''
    if isinstance(result, dict):
        result.pop('header', None)

import json
try:
    vars['close_state'] = 'pending'
    s = json.loads(vars.get('state_json', '{}'))
    outcome = s.get('close_outcome', '')
    reason = s.get('close_reason', '')
    if s.get('transferred'):
        outcome = 'transferred'
        reason = 'human' if s['transferred'] == 'general' else s['transferred']
    elif s.get('verified') and s.get('loaded'):
        ps = s.get('products', [])
        if any(p.get('status') == 'recorded' for p in ps):
            outcome = 'promise'
            reason = ''
        elif ps and all(p.get('noted') and p.get('reason') == 'paid' for p in ps):
            outcome = 'paid'
            reason = ''
        else:
            nonpaid = [p for p in ps if p.get('noted') and p.get('reason') != 'paid']
            if nonpaid:
                outcome = 'no_promise'
                reason = nonpaid[0]['reason']
    body = dict(customer_id=vars.get('customer_id', ''), outcome=outcome)
    if outcome not in ['promise', 'paid']:
        body['reason'] = reason
    config['body'] = body
    s['close_attempted'] = True
    vars['state_json'] = json.dumps(s)
    vars['closing_outcome'] = outcome
    vars['closing_reason'] = reason
except Exception:
    vars['close_state'] = 'unavailable'
